comments.author: @GeirArneMoi
comments.text: This is what Americans want to watch - I thought when I saw the first few minutes, but after a while I got a bit flabbergasted by the things that was pointed out: of course there are tragedies and personal doom for people in the Nordic countries and Sweden is the country that mimic USA most - some 20% of the population own around 60% of all income and fortunes that private people own. Of course this should be compared to the US state of affairs: 1 man owns as much as half the people of USA. There are executions in USA, even botched ones. You have a police force that enjoy harassing dark skinned people and the poorest white ones by traffic stops that would be completely unheard of here in Scandinavia. I have been cursed with bad health and have not been able to work more than 20 years - still I have an income with a net monthly pay of 3500 US dollars. This is more than enough to live in comfort and not worry about calling an ambulance or going to the doctor or any other stuff that would kill most Americans with the bills coming in. UK has a very noticeable lower standard of living than Norwegians, and if I had to rely on the dole in UK I would live a very bad life. Is not a sickness that makes you unable to work more than enough punishment if this illness should not make you a beggar in addition? The word the Americans don't understand, is "empathy". The standard US citizen suffers a workaholic environment that makes them die ten years before the average Nordic people. Ten years! I would rather not have Americans trying to find the slightest fault in our countries when they accept the highest infant mortality in the world, that record belongs to Detroit - not Nigeria or any other African country still suffering the greedy English and French (mostly) squeezing the last cent out of them before leaving them to themselves after the second world war, with no one having been educated and we have seen starving masses of people that have to watch the foreigners take their produced food and leaving nothing to those who made this food. The white people of Europe have done much harm to the world and keep doing it, but compared to USA we Europeans look like saints.
